title: Privacy wallet contract composed with Clairveil binding and client handoff — draft
description: Closed Clairveil profile, not a protocol-neutral universal API. Method roles, binding data and execution responsibilities are separate; the composed profile keeps one wire registry.

ClairveilBindingId.description: Named protocol binding; not an EVM/Cosmos chain identifier or a submission mode.

selfViewEnabled.description: Optional; omitted means true. False requires explicit trusted UI opt-out approval.

SupportedMethods.description: Enabled methods for this Clairveil composition, not grants or a universal privacy-wallet baseline. Core lifecycle methods are required; public chain actions require client-handoff and reconciliation.

ClairveilPrivacyConstraints.description: Optional request restrictions for this Clairveil execution profile, not consent or anonymity guarantees. Either false is well-formed but unsatisfiable by the current profile; admission fails with 4213. Omission retains existing explicit consent requirements.

RecoveryAccess.description: Explicit recovery-only grant for pre-existing owned chain operations; never authority for new work, publication or dispatch.
